pages.title: The Spear and the Charge
pages.text: Aurelia fights with a long spear: a wound-up thrust when you're close, and a headlong charge when you back away. She grows faster and hits harder as she's worn down, across three stages - so don't spend your openings early.

pages.title: Aurelia's Spear
pages.text: Her relic, kept by whoever beats her: a blade a little stronger than diamond, with two extra blocks of reach - a spear in all but name. It can't burn, and the void won't keep it.
